title: Uncovering Cultural Representation Disparities in Vision-Language Models
reasoning: The paper investigates cultural and geographical representation biases in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) by evaluating their accuracy in identifying 211 countries. While it notes that models occasionally use religious context (like 'Buddhist and Hindu contexts') as visual cues for reasoning, the study does not specifically benchmark or evaluate religion, faith, morals, or ethics as primary components.
